story.en: Musafir started in 2012 as a two-desk ticketing office in Banani. Our founders saw Bangladeshi travellers paying hidden fees, chasing visa files and getting little help once abroad. We set out to fix that with transparent BDT prices, real humans on WhatsApp and trips designed by people who have walked every route.
